offer.text: The fish bite best in the rain, if you've the patience for it. Land me 4 cod while the weather holds.

accept.text: Aye, get out there before the clouds break.

decline.text: The rain won't last, and neither will the chance.

ready.text: Four fat cod, rain-caught and the best kind. Nicely done.

complete.text: Only a true angler fishes through a storm. My respect.
